related.title: 月球網路的存放轉送與資料時效
related.transfer: 沿機上通訊、地面天線、解調與資料路由對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across onboard radio, ground antenna, demodulation, and routing.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的鏈路預算及可用窗口表；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable link budget and availability-window table. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 完成「月球網路的存放轉送與資料時效」工作台並留下可重做的工程紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Complete the lunar delay-tolerant store-and-forward and expiration bench and produce a reproducible engineering record.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.
